policy: Hand-picked, open-licensed Wikimedia Commons photographs for the first screen of 现在去哪儿. Every file keeps its author, licence and source page; the server resolves the metadata from Commons at request time. Places without an entry fall back to Wikidata P18, preferring a larger landscape photograph when the canonical image is small or portrait.
